race.comment: CARDAMOM (11) gets the nod in no small part due to the rare presence of J Mac on an Anthony and Sam Freedman runner. Opened this prep with an eye-catching second over 1200m at Sale. Fitter and this trip is more to her liking. Should be right there at the business end. GIRIJAALA (5) chimed in late to just miss the placings when fresh from a spell over 1300m at Randwick recently. Strips fitter and is back in grade so expect her to be thereabouts. MOSGOLD (12) finished less than three lengths from the winner in the Barn Dance last start after a couple of sound lead-up runs. At her best over 1400m so at the fourth run back this looks a nice set-up. Massive early odds very appealing. Recent Kembla trial winner PIERRO LAD (3) is capable of a big run while fresh for the Ciaron Maher stable. CRUIZINGTHESTARS (7) wasn't too far off them in the Barn Dance last start. Very fit after three runs back.
